about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Momo Nepali Steamed Chicken Dumplings with Tomato Dip
recipes.summary: Juicy steamed chicken dumplings with ginger and coriander, served with a tangy roasted tomato dip.
steps: Mix the chicken, onion, half the garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, soy sauce and oil with 1/2 tsp salt until sticky.
Place a heaped teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, then pleat the edges closed.
Grill the tomatoes under a hot grill for 8 minutes until blackened, then blend with the remaining garlic, chilli powder and a pinch of salt.
Steam the momo in batches in an oiled steamer for 12 minutes until the wrappers turn translucent.
Serve hot with the tomato dip.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken filling until it reaches 75°C in the centre of a dumpling. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Veg Momo Nepali Cabbage and Paneer Dumplings
recipes.summary: Steamed dumplings filled with cabbage, carrot and crumbled paneer, with a chilli and sesame dip.
steps: Salt the cabbage with 1/2 tsp salt, rest for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Mix the cabbage with the carrot, paneer, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, vegetable oil and cumin.
Fill and pleat the wrappers, using a heaped teaspoon each.
Steam for 12 minutes until the wrappers are translucent.
Stir the sesame oil, chilli powder and a splash of soy sauce for the dip and serve alongside.

recipes.title: Manti Afghan Beef Dumplings with Garlic Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Baked and steamed beef and onion dumplings under garlic yoghurt, tomato sauce and dried mint.
steps: Mix the beef with one onion, the coriander and 1/2 tsp salt. Fill the wrappers and pinch each into a small parcel.
Bake the manti on an oiled tray at 200°C for 15 minutes until lightly golden.
Soften the other onion in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, add the turmeric and tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Drop the manti into the sauce with 1/2 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir the garlic into the yoghurt, spoon over the manti and scatter with mint.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef filling until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mantu Afghan Pumpkin Dumplings with Lentil Sauce
recipes.summary: Vegetarian dumplings stuffed with spiced pumpkin and onion, finished with yoghurt and a lentil tomato sauce.
steps: Cook the pumpkin and one onion in 1 tbsp oil for 12 minutes until soft, then stir in the coriander, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Fill and fold the wrappers with a heaped teaspoon each.
Simmer the lentils with the remaining onion, oil, turmeric, tomatoes and 2 cups water for 20 minutes until thick.
Steam the dumplings for 12 minutes until the wrappers turn translucent.
Stir the garlic into the yoghurt and serve over the dumplings with the lentil sauce.

recipes.title: Jiaozi Chive and Egg Dumplings with Black Vinegar Dip
recipes.summary: Boiled dumplings full of soft egg, garlic chives and glass noodles, served with a sharp black vinegar dip.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 5 minutes, drain and chop finely.
Scramble the eggs in the oil over medium heat for 2 minutes until just set, then break up and cool.
Mix the egg with the chives, vermicelli, sesame oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1/2 tsp salt.
Fill and seal the wrappers, using a heaped teaspoon each.
Boil in batches for 4 minutes until they float, then drain.
Mix the rest of the soy sauce, vinegar and ginger and serve for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set and the filling until it reaches 75°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Shengjian Bao Shanghai Pan-Fried Pork Buns
recipes.summary: Fluffy buns with a crisp sesame base and a juicy pork and spring onion filling.
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water into a smooth dough, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Mix the pork with half the spring onions, soy sauce, ginger, sesame oil and 1/4 cup water until sticky.
Divide the dough into 12 balls, flatten, fill with a spoonful of pork and pleat to seal.
Heat the oil in a lidded non-stick pan, add the buns seam-side down and fry for 3 minutes until golden.
Add 1/3 cup water, cover and steam for 10 minutes, then uncover and cook until the water has gone.
Scatter with sesame seeds and remaining spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the centre of a bun. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Nikuman Japanese Steamed Pork Buns
recipes.summary: Soft white steamed buns around a gently sweet pork, cabbage and shiitake filling.
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water into a smooth dough, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Mix the pork, cabbage, shiitake, soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil and ginger until sticky.
Divide the dough into 8, roll into rounds, fill each and gather the edges to seal.
Steam on baking paper squares for 15 minutes until puffed and firm.
Serve warm with soy sauce or chilli sauce for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kimchi Mandu Korean Pork Dumplings
recipes.summary: Pan-fried pork and kimchi dumplings with tofu for a tender filling and a soy dipping sauce.
steps: Mix the pork, kimchi, tofu, spring onions, garlic and sesame oil.
Fill and seal the wrappers with a heaped teaspoon each.
Fry in the oil for 2 minutes until the bases are golden, add 1/3 cup water, cover and steam for 6 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce and vinegar for dipping and serve with the mandu.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Banh Bao Vietnamese Steamed Pork and Egg Buns
recipes.summary: Pillowy steamed buns filled with seasoned pork, mushrooms and a quarter of boiled egg.

items: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and chopped

steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and cut into quarters, keeping 8 pieces.
Mix the pork, mushrooms, spring onions, fish sauce and pepper.
Divide the dough into 8 rounds, fill each with pork and a piece of egg, then seal.
Steam for 18 minutes until puffed and the pork is cooked through.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Siopao Asado Filipino Steamed Pork Buns
recipes.summary: Fluffy steamed buns with a sticky sweet soy pork filling in the Filipino style.
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Brown the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, add the pork, soy sauce, brown sugar and 1/2 cup water, and simmer for 30 minutes until tender.
Stir the cornflour with 2 tbsp water into the pork and simmer for 2 minutes until thick, then cool.
Divide the dough into 8, fill each round and seal.
Steam for 15 minutes until puffed.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Yakitori Chicken Thigh Skewers with Tare Glaze
recipes.summary: Chicken thigh pieces grilled on skewers and brushed with a glossy soy and mirin glaze, served with rice.

items: 600g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger for 6 minutes until syrupy.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Thread the chicken and spring onion alternately onto soaked bamboo sticks.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze, until golden.
Serve over the rice with the remaining glaze.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Boil any glaze used on raw chicken before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Seekh Kebab Pakistani Spiced Lamb Skewers
recipes.summary: Minced lamb with ginger, garlic and spices moulded on skewers and grilled, with mint yoghurt and flatbread.
steps: Knead the lamb with the onion, ginger, garlic, spices, coriander and 1 tsp salt for 3 minutes until sticky.
Mould around 8 flat skewers into long sausages and chill while the grill heats.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until browned.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and serve with the kebabs and warm flatbreads.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C throughout. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fish Moilee Kerala Mild Coconut Fish Curry
recipes.summary: A gentle turmeric and coconut milk curry with firm fish, ideal for children, served with rice.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 6 minutes without browning.
Stir in the turmeric, tomato, coconut milk and 1/2 tsp salt and simmer for 6 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Add the fish and poach for 6 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Serve with the rice while hot, and spoon the sauce over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Macher Jhol Bengali Light Fish Curry with Potatoes
recipes.summary: A thin, fragrant turmeric and cumin fish stew with potatoes and tomato, served with rice.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps: Rub the fish with half the turmeric and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil, fry the potatoes for 6 minutes until golden at the edges, then add the ginger, cumin, chilli, tomato and remaining turmeric.
Add 2 cups water, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the potato is tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Slide in the fish and simmer gently for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sarisha Maach Mustard-Paste Fish with Rice
recipes.summary: Fish gently cooked in a ground mustard and mustard oil sauce, a Bengali favourite, served with rice.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps: Soak the mustard seeds in warm water for 10 minutes if possible, then blend with the chillies and 1/2 cup water until smooth.
Rub the fish with turmeric and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil, add the mustard paste and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Add the fish, cover and cook gently for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with the rice while hot, and spoon the sauce over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Amok Trey Cambodian Steamed Fish in Coconut Curry
recipes.summary: Fish in a lemongrass and coconut curry custard steamed in small bowls, served with rice.
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, eggs, curry paste, fish sauce and sugar until smooth.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Fold the fish through the custard and divide among four heatproof bowls lined with spinach.
Steam for 20 minutes until the custard is set and the fish is cooked.
Serve with the rice while hot, and spoon the sauce over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the custard and fish until set and the fish reaches 63°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lok Lak Cambodian Pepper Beef with Lime Dip
recipes.summary: Seared beef cubes in a soy and oyster glaze over lettuce and tomato with a lime and pepper dip.
steps: Mix the beef with oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and garlic.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Sear the beef in the oil in two batches over high heat for 3 minutes each until browned.
Mix the lime juice, pepper and a pinch of salt for the dip.
Serve the beef on lettuce and tomato with the rice and dip.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef pieces until they reach 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Laap Lao Minced Pork with Toasted Rice and Herbs
recipes.summary: Warm minced pork with lime, chilli, toasted rice and herbs, served with sticky rice.
steps: Soak the glutinous rice for 1 hour if time allows, then steam for 25 minutes.
Toast the jasmine rice in a dry pan until golden and grind coarsely.
Cook the pork in a splash of water for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Off the heat stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, toasted rice, chilli flakes, herbs and spring onions.
Serve with the sticky rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mohinga Burmese Fish Curry with Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: A comforting Burmese catfish-style stew with lemongrass, turmeric and chickpea flour served over rice noodles.

items: 500g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Soften the onion, garlic and lemongrass in the oil for 8 minutes, add the turmeric and 4 cups water, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Whisk the chickpea flour with 1/2 cup water and stir in with the fish sauce, then simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thick.
Add the fish and poach for 6 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and halve.
Soak or boil the noodles until tender, divide among bowls, ladle over the stew, top with egg and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C, and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ginataang Hipon Filipino Prawns in Coconut Milk
recipes.summary: Prawns simmered in garlicky coconut milk with chilli, served with steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Simmer the onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and coconut milk for 8 minutes.
Add the prawns and fish sauce and cook for 4 minutes until pink and curled.
Serve over the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lu Rou Fan Taiwanese Braised Pork Belly Rice
recipes.summary: Pork belly braised in soy, rice wine and fried shallots until sticky, spooned over rice with a boiled egg.

items: 700g pork belly, cut in small pieces

steps: Brown the pork belly in a dry pot for 8 minutes until the fat renders.
Add the soy sauce, wine, sugar, shallots, star anise, ginger and 3 cups water, then simmer covered for 1 hour.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel, and add to the pot for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Spoon the pork and sauce over the rice with an egg each.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and tender, and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sanbei Ji Taiwanese Three-Cup Chicken with Basil
recipes.summary: Chicken braised with sesame oil, soy and rice wine until sticky, finished with fistfuls of basil.

items: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Heat the sesame oil, then fry the ginger and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, wine, sugar and 1/2 cup water, cover, and simmer 12 minutes until almost dry.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Stir through the basil and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Singapore-Style Chilli Prawns with Fried Bread
recipes.summary: Prawns in a sweet-sour tomato and chilli sauce with ribbons of egg, mopped up with toasted bread.
steps: Fry the garlic and ginger in the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, paste, chilli sauce and 1/2 cup water, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes until pink.
Beat the eggs and pour in slowly while stirring to form ribbons, cooking 1 minute.
Toast the bread until golden and serve for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside, and the egg until set. Contains shellfish and egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dal Makhani Punjabi Black Lentil and Kidney Bean Plate
recipes.summary: Slow-simmered creamy lentils and kidney beans with tomato and a little butter, served with rice.
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, beans and 2 cups water and simmer 40 minutes, mashing some beans.
Stir in the cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then serve the dal over it until the plates are full.
